objects.name: delivery_outbox
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE delivery_outbox (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  dedupe_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,      -- e.g. 'order|ORD-1|email' | 'tg|<requestId>|chunk_0' | 'cron|<key>'
  order_id TEXT,                        -- order id when channel-bound to an order; dedupe_key otherwise
  channel TEXT NOT NULL,                -- 'email' | 'telegram'
  recipient TEXT NOT NULL,
  subject TEXT,
  body TEXT,
  attachment_names TEXT,                -- 'kind:file_name,...' (bytes resolved from storage at send time)
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING', -- PENDING | SENDING | SENT | FAILED
  attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  last_error TEXT,
  provider_message_id TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  updated_at TEXT
)

objects.name: event_log

objects.name: execution_state

)

objects.name: order_ledger
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE order_ledger (
  order_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  client_email TEXT,
  tx_hash TEXT,
  quote_ref INTEGER,
  status TEXT NOT NULL,
  error TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  updated_at TEXT
, "qa_status" TEXT, "qa_report" TEXT, "payment_status" TEXT, "amount_paid" REAL, "price_source" TEXT, "expected_amount" REAL, "file_name" TEXT, "file_ext" TEXT, "rows_in" INTEGER, "rows_out" INTEGER, "delivery_channel" TEXT, "delivery_status" TEXT, product_id TEXT, settlement_mode TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'MOCK' CHECK (settlement_mode IN ('REAL','TESTNET','SIMULATION','MOCK')), chain_id TEXT, settlement_integrity INTEGER AS (CASE WHEN ((settlement_mode IN ('REAL','TESTNET') AND tx_hash IS NOT NULL AND tx_hash!='' AND chain_id IS NOT NULL AND chain_id!='') OR (settlement_mode IN ('SIMULATION','MOCK') AND (chain_id IS NULL OR chain_id=''))) THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) VIRTUAL NOT NULL)
